'''Masashi Hirose''' (Japanese: '''広瀬正志''' ''Hirose Masashi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hirose was born on November 6, 1947, in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He first provided the voice of [[Poké Ball]] smith [[Kurt]] in {{aniseries|GS}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. He then returned during {{aniseries|BW}}, voicing [[character of the day]] [[Professor Malveaux]]. Hirose is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Production Baobab}}.
